o: This season, the family faces the devastating passing of Janelle and Kody's son, Garrison Brown. Through the heartbreaking pain, the family navigates this incredible tragedy and comes together to mourn and celebrate his life. There has been much change over the past few years, where all the Browns are facing new pathways forward. While three of Kody's wives have left, his fourth wife Robyn…

eps.o: Things get awkward as Kody, Robyn and Christine see each other for the first time in months at Mykelti's baby sprinkle. Meri tells her friend Brandi that she's done with Kody. Janelle reveals that she's looking at buying property in Montana.

Janelle considers leaving Flagstaff for good as she and Maddie look at land in Montana. Kody learns that Meri is asking their church for a "release," their religion's word for a divorce. Christine and Aspyn throw Ysabel a welcome home party.

After reuniting at a wedding, Kody describes the family dynamic as a total civil war. Christine and Robyn reunite in the waiting room as Mykelti welcomes her twins via c-section. At a game night with Robyn and their kids, Kody reflects on his 3 failed marriages.

The Brown family spends Thanksgiving apart. Christine and Robyn put their differences aside to visit with Mykelti's newborns. Robyn pushes Kody to reconcile with his kids. Then, Christine reveals that she went on a promising first date.

Meri asks the church for a release from her marriage to Kody. Gabe opens up to Janelle about his relationship with his father. Christine is excited for her second date with David. Mykelti reveals she ate her placenta. Robyn is left in tears on Christmas.

eps.t: He Delivered Me From All My Fears

eps.o: Kody helps Meri prepare to move away and they joke about their divorce. Christine and David look at wedding venues after only 2 months of dating which leaves her kids thinking things are moving too fast.
Kody suggests reconciling with Janelle but she flatly refuses when he continues to prioritize Robyn.
Janelle warns Meri on trusting Kody about the Coyote Pass property and despite only dating a few months, Christine and David go house shopping.

eps.t: A Man After My Own Heart
eps.o: Christine and David's relationship continues at light speed when they go off-roading in Moab and David gets down on one knee.
Kody sobs after helping Meri move away from Flagstaff leaving Meri confused about why he has pushed her away for so many years.
As the deadline to pay off Coyote Pass looms, tensions rise over how the family will divide the property
Christine goes shopping for her dream wedding dress while Meri meets with two of her friends and struggles to come to grips with her new reality.

eps.t: The Truth Will Set You Free
eps.o: Kody and Robyn go on a date and Kody rails against their former church and Christine and David host an engagement party with some very messy tacos.
Robyn's girls explore non-mormon churches and Kody struggles to keep quiet about it.

eps.t: A Time To Weep, a Time To Laugh
eps.o: Meri cuts up a quilt that celebrated her marriage to Kody and Christine and David are in Moab preparing for their magical day.

eps.t: Love is Patient, Love is Kind
eps.o: It's a joyful event on the banks of the Colorado River as Christine and David say, "I do" and Kody discusses missing out on the Brown family celebration and has a scary close call while cutting down a tree.

eps.t: Money is the Root of All Evil
eps.o: Christine and Janelle each reveal big new chapters in their lives and Kody meets with a realtor at Coyote Pass.

eps.t: Behold I Come Like a Thief
eps.o: anelle and Meri join forces to finally get answers about Coyote Pass but Kody is having doubts about letting it go.

eps.t: For Everything There is a Season
eps.o: On a road trip across the country to move Janelle to North Carolina, Christine, Janelle and David stop at a bar where Janelle has her first shot ever.

eps.t: The Land of Milk and Honey?
eps.o: With Christine's help, Janelle moves her life from Flagstaff to North Carolina and sees the land that she purchased sight unseen. Meri questions her entire relationship with Robyn. Kody prepares to baptize Aurora into a new church.

Christine is excited to spend her first monogamous Valentine's Day with David. Meri and Janelle meet at Coyote Pass to discuss a strategy moving forward. Robyn and Kody discuss not being polygamists anymore.

eps.t: The Stars Will Fall From the Sky
eps.o: As Christine's new dynamic with David continues to flourish, she realizes that she was more alone with Kody than she understood.
Janelle visits the Flagstaff Humane Society to view a plaque that they have dedicated to her son Garrison.
The family has gathered in Wyoming to honor Garrison and lay him to rest in the family plot next to his grandparents.
The Brown family sit down individually to discuss their past and future. As Christine says she tried to make her relationship with Kody work, he says that the wives all had the same chances as Robyn.
As the One-on-One conversations continue, Janelle opens up about her dislike for both Kody and Robyn.
In part three of this One-on-One interview special, Meri discusses her distrust over Coyote Pass.
In this final episode of the One-on-One interviews, David gives his thoughts on polygamy and the role men play within it.
